CrocoDash is a Python package I develop under the [CROCODILE-CESM](https://github.com/CROCODILE-CESM) project at NCAR. It sets up regional MOM6 ocean simulations inside the Community Earth System Model, so researchers can build high-resolution regional configurations without managing the whole model infrastructure by hand.
